annotations.title: Record whether the company got in touch

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. For a referral request the signed-in user sent that a referrer already referred (status referred): records whether the company got in touch with the user. Saving again updates the answer.

answer.description: yes = the company contacted the user, no = it did not.

request_id.description: Id of one of the user's own requests, from list_referral_requests.

name: confirm_referral_contact

action.description: The action that was applied: resubmit or confirm_contact.

status.description: The request's new status, when the action changed it.

title: Record whether the company got in touch
